section: Global technology security leader: Microsoft Teams and Neat refresh of more than 400 rooms in 30 locations
body:
An unnamed global technology security company, listed with a Washington, USA location, worked with AVI-SPL on a worldwide collaboration refresh and support arrangement covering 30 locations. The case study is proof of a standardized Microsoft Teams rollout at global scale for a security-conscious organization.

**The problem**
- The company was preparing a widespread return-to-work strategy, but its AV/UC infrastructure was not ready for it.
- Offices in 30 locations in 18 countries on five continents relied on outdated technology.
- Its centralized meeting space control platform was approaching an unexpected end-of-life. Vince Clarke, AVI-SPL account manager, said rooms held older touch panels and equipment due to become obsolete in a matter of seven months.
- IT had to change collaboration platform and refresh more than 400 rooms around the world.

**Room types at each site**
- A collaboration (huddle) room
- A medium-sized meeting space (8-12 people)
- A large conference room (14-20 people)
- A lounge
- A training room
- All-hands/game spaces

**Decisions and AVI-SPL's role**
- Microsoft Teams was chosen as the collaboration platform, with Neat solutions as the core meeting space technology.
- It needed a global technology integration provider so each component would be installed and launched efficiently in every region.
- It partnered with AVI-SPL to design the AV/UC environment and guide each phase, from strategy to deployment to management.
- The page's summary lists the services as Professional Services, Training Services and Enterprise Elite, and the solution as Biamp, Logitech, Microsoft Teams, Neat and Sony.

**Results as stated**
- AVI-SPL enabled IT to roll out Microsoft Teams within its security standards and get quick adoption of the platform.
- The standardized AV/UC solution supported productivity and collaboration across five continents.
- The introduction of Enterprise Elite Maintenance is said to have set a confident tone for room management and space optimization.
- Clarke said IT is pleased with the solution and the Enterprise Elite service, and that conversations about AVI-SPL's Enterprise Managed Services offering are starting. That is a discussion, not a purchase.
- The success of these services is supporting further AV and UC needs, including cloud administration, plus video production for executive broadcasts such as corporate town hall meetings.
- The page also notes that organizations may qualify for Microsoft funding for this type of project, and that AVI-SPL's Microsoft Practice can review available programs.

**When to use this**
For questions about global room refreshes, replacing an end-of-life room control platform, or Neat with Microsoft Teams at scale.

**Not stated in this source**
No measured adoption or support figures, costs, or the name of the retired control platform.
